Personal Data Protection
Act 2012
2020 REVISED EDITION
This revised edition incorporates the amendments made up to a stated date and comes into operation on a later date
An Act to govern the collection, use and disclosure of personal data by organisations, and to establish the Do Not Call Register
[22/2016]
and to provide for its administration, and for matters connected therewith.
[2 January 2013: Parts I, II, VIII, IX (except sections 36 to 38, 41 and 43 to 48) and X (except section 67(1)), and the First, Seventh and Ninth Schedules ;
2 December 2013: Sections 36, 37, 38 and 41 ;
2 July 2014: Parts III to VII, and the Second to Sixth Schedules]
Be it enacted by the Parliament of Singapore as follows:
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
Short title
1.  This Act is the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.
Purpose
3.  The purpose of this Act is to govern how organisations handle personal data, with regard to both the rights of individuals and the needs of organisations.
